lines.text: Countless red lights shoot towards Marian.
After narrowly avoiding the attacks, Marian reaches her hand to the sky.
*Krrkkk!*
She gathers Dark Matter into the form of a giant spear and throws it at the Goddess of Victory statue.
The black spear flies through the air and hits its target.
However, it immediately crumbles, and the damage to the statue is repaired.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... Yeah, I'm pretty sure I can't do this alone...
Red lights again start to pour from the statue like rain.
As Marian dodges and blocks the attacks, she grows certain.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... It's just trying to keep me in check. It's like it doesn't see me as anything more than a pesky bug.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: What it's really trying to do is...
Marian hears a familiar sound start to ring.
Red light gathers around the top of the statue.
The surroundings are painted again in the ominous red light that's been used twice to attack the Ark.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: That's so fast...! How can it output this much energy...?!
It's clear that the Ark blocked the second attack. She has no idea how, but there was no explosion.
Still, she's not sure whether they can stop it again.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'll have to make another world...
*Flash!*
*Boom!*
An enormous beam of white and pink light shoots from the sky and strikes the top of the statue.
The red light scatters, and the statue shakes.

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: Direct hit!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: ... Is it just me, or did that look stronger than the Wings of Victory's main guns?

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: N-no way! No one's stronger than Zoomie!
Andersen waves away the smoke coming from Dorothy's and Snow White's guns.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Excellent. That was a blow right to the Queen's big, ugly head. Not that it has a head, but you get the idea.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Still, I'm sure it'll just regenerate.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Then we just need to keep hitting it until it stops.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: That's true. That's all we have to do.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Can we approach no closer? My blade grows restless, and I with it.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: It's hard to get too close to her with that gravity field.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Hmph. Against such a foe, a sword hath little... Hm?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... Behold Marian below.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Oh good, she's... Huh?
Dark Matter gathers beneath Marian.
It sinks down, then quickly catapults Marian upward.
Everyone on deck stares dumbfounded at Marian as she flies up to their level.
She lands on deck and looks at everyone.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'm so glad you're here.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... Didst thou leap hither from so far below?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Oh, yes. I made the Dark Matter contract, then quickly expanded it at once.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Thou shouldst study the sword. 'Twould fit well with thy talents.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Not this again.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: What I say to her I say to thee, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: No thanks.

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Evasive maneuvers!

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: The Queen is attacking!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: Everyone hold on tight!
A barrage of beams burst from the statue and shoot toward the Wings of Victory.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... It'd be easier to dodge a spray of sand than that.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: On it.
Rapunzel lifts her staff.
A golden tent covers the ship, blocking the statue's attack.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Looks like you have no problem with an attack of that size. Good.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: You couldn't handle anything bigger, though, could you?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: B-bigger...? Oh... Ohh... Something much bigger would be... too much...!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... Can someone do something about her?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Let's keep making circles around the Queen and attacking it.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Captain, Rapunzel's shield isn't all-powerful, so we'll need to maneuver around the Queen like, um...

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... Basically, try your best to move around her like a fly.

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Like a... fly?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can't think of a better way to phrase it...

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Okay... I'll just buzz around and keep bothering her... like a fly...

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... Please don't get too close, though. We want to avoid the gravity field.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Not that I think a gravity field would be able to easily pull in something of this size, but there's no harm in being careful.

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: The lives of the Goddess Squad are in your hands.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: We're counting on you.

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: You got it! Captain Sky will keep all of you legends safe!

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: I'm glad she's so simple.

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: No kidding.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Now, our opponent is an absurdly large monster that can do transport, offense, and defense all at once. We should assume it's capable of production, too.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Its energy output is too much to calculate, and it can also regenerate itself and create gravity fields.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: What are you going to do, Dorothy?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Please don't use the Wings of Victory's weapons unless needed.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Projectiles might get launched this way, and we have no idea when the Heretics will make an appearance.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: The ship's weapons should be used as emergency defensive measures.

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: Yeah, sure thing ☆

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Snow White and I will keep aiming for the origin of the statue's beam.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Don't worry about running out of ammo. Just keep attacking at maximum output, and I'll do the same.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Will that really work, though? That thing's going to keep regenerating.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: If we keep hitting it, it'll reach its limit at some point.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: It's the most flawless plan you've ever come up with.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Rapunzel, if you judge an attack to be dangerous, put up your shield. Leaving it up at all times would be too much, even for that body of yours.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: You can trust the Wings of Victory to deal with the smaller attacks.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: All right, sure.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: And... Marian, was it?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Yes, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: What can you do?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'll focus on the Queen's body. I can gradually put more and more of my Dark Matter into it, which should slow it down at least a little.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: We won't see it work right away due to that thing's size, but if I keep at it, it'll start to have an effect.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Also, I can stop it from moving temporarily.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Good. I'll leave that to you then.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: What shall I do?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Hmm, I suppose you can stay behind us and do a sword dance.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Want me to join you? I know how to tap dance.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I shall decline. Get thee gone.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: All right, let's do this!
*Whoooosh!*
The Wings of Victory picks up speed.
Rapunzel blocks the beams shooting out from the statue with her shield.
The ship dodges the larger beams with evasive maneuvers.
Dorothy and Snow White focus their attacks on the statue's neck, preventing the large beam from firing.
Marian pierces the statue ceaselessly with black spears, hampering its movements.
Everyone aboard the Wings of Victory has the same thought:
We just might win.
Somewhere inside the Goddess of Victory statue...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: There's a large fly buzzing around and being a nuisance.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Those human imposters are doing pretty well. They even brought the Ark to the surface...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: They also managed to block the Queen's beam.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Scarlet, Rapunzel, and now that scum from Eden... They just keep getting stronger and popping back up again.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: And Dorothy...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hehe, I never imagined she'd go back to them.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: When I suggested increasing our ranks, Dorothy was the first one you picked out.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I thought it was an excellent call. It was impossible to deny that it would've been the best way to mess with their heads.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Despite the hurried surgery to turn her into a Heretic, she even managed to transform. She really is quite something.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I had such high hopes for her...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: But she disappointingly went right back to them.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I sent her to attack the Ark, and yet all she did was take in the scenery.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Granted, I never expected Dorothy alone to flip the whole situation around.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You just happened to pick Dorothy, and there just happened to be someone with Vapaus in the Ark.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: And that person just happened to be her old Commander.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Nayuta.
Nayuta stops operating the machine she is at and turns her head to Mirror.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You're not actually of a sound mind right now, are you?
Nayuta stares at Mirror without responding.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... Heh, of course not. There's no way.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Then there's Marian. She's back after inheriting the power from that fake Queen made by those half-baked pieces of junk.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She's grown a bit more useful than before, but she still can't hold a candle to the now-perfect Queen.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: *Sigh...* It's really a shame, Nayuta.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: How could the Queen you and I worked so hard to create turn out like that?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You really should've chosen the right side. You need to learn how to read a situation.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: With those red eyes of yours.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... It's odd, though.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The fake Queen that those pieces of junk made...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It clearly overpowered the Queen. I know it's rude to say, but she could've beaten her.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: So why didn't she? And why give her gene to Marian?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hehe, well... I'm sure it was for some ridiculous reason, like a sense of purpose or determination or some such.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Those sorts of things are usually a short-cut to disaster, and it won't be any different this time.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: *Sigh...* It's not fun talking to myself.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Is everything going well over there?
Nayuta nods.
Satisfaction appears on Mirror's face as she looks at the many things lining the wall.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hehe, good. I can't wait to see how those fools in the Ark react when we send all of those things at them at once.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Once you reach a number you like, send them over right away.
Nayuta nods.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You must have a strong ego too. Despite being corrupted, you still know what you want.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I have a lot of doubts myself.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I'm always wondering just how much self-awareness to give a puppet.
Nayuta continues operating the machine without a word.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You're no fun to talk to.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Keep up the good work.
Mirror crackles and disappears.
Nayuta continues to silently work the machine.
Mirror looks at Egovista and Altruia, hooked up to a series of wires.
She gives a command to a Rapture, who goes and operates a machine.
The wires pop off one by one, and Egovista and Altruia fall to the floor.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Time to wake up.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Ahh...

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Ahhh...!

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I feel it.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Am I within Mother?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Thanks to your help, the Queen's transformation was a success.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You should be happy. She had to work so hard to transform after she changed bodies,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: and she only managed to do it thanks to your support.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: In other words, you were of great help to her.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Ohhh... Greater honor... there could not be!

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: What is Mother doing now?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She's attacking the human imposters' base, looking more dignified than ever.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: There is still an annoying fly buzzing around, but there are no major issues.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I see. I take it you need us to chase this fly away?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: No. There are others who are giving her even more trouble.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I want you to take care of them.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: The ones we ran into before?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Yes. I don't think they pose any real threat to the Queen,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: but she'd be so delighted to have one less nuisance to deal with.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I understand. I'll leave right away.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Good. Go take care of it then.
Altruia disappears.
Egovista stares at the wall in a daze.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Egovista...?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: ... 'Tis a machine.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: A machine. Wheresoever I cast mine eyes, 'tis all a machine.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Is there a problem with that?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: It doth spur questions within me.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: If it's something I can answer, then ask away.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Wherefore speaketh Mother not unto us herself?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Why, because she's so busy.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Too busy to afford one single word?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: What are you trying to say?
Egovista runs her hand over a device on the wall.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Is she naught but a mere machine...?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I mean to strike down Scarlet. Where is she?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The Queen is fighting her.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Then I shall take part.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: No, don't. There's something else that's giving us more trouble.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Thou canst not command me.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: But I can report you for acting rashly without assessing the situation.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... Once you are done with the more urgent matter, I will arrange a place for your grand sword fight.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Resist the urge for now.
Egovista disappears without a word.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Huh... an entity without a heart managed to make entities with hearts.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hehe... How absurd.
The AZX continues to dart across the surface.
The ground is covered in the remains of innumerable Raptures, but the train doesn't stop.
After some time...
... the enormous Goddess of Victory statue appears on the horizon, small and distant,
as does the Wings of Victory, flying around the statue and attacking it.
The Goddess Squad and the Queen are fighting.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yes, and it would appear that Marian has safely joined up with the Goddess Squad.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah, you can see those black spears shooting from the ship.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Whoa, all three of you have really good eyesight.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: How can you not see it? You're wearing glasses.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: The idea that people who wear glasses can see well is a harmful stereotype.
Diesel listens to our conversation with a smile, when suddenly her face stiffens.
She stares out the window before saying something to Brid.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: ... Did you see this, Brid? There's water on the window.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Yeah, the ground is really wet at the moment. Don't worry, though. It won't affect our speed.
It's... wet?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wow, for a second I thought you were Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm impressed, Commander. Even in a situation like this, you don't miss a chance to respond to that kind of thing.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I-I don't know if it's incredible or worrisome...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'd say incredible. He's being loyal to his instincts.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: They say too much of that can be bad for you. Don't overdo it.
I ignore everyone's passionate support and look out the window.
I see a ridge far up ahead, and get the feeling that something's going on behind it.
After staring for a while, I start to see something.
... I catch glimpses of familiar giant tentacles and large, dark shapes.
Is that... Liberalio... and the Four Beasts?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What?
The Four Beasts are in combat with a transformed Liberalio!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: They're what?! Wait, is that why they stayed behind...?!
Brid! Change course to...!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Don't be stupid. We need to prioritize what's most important, especially at times like this.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: The Queen comes first.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Tch, I can't believe you would still make such a rookie move.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: But we can't just pass by and pretend we didn't see anything.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Absolute will get off here.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: O-okay.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Yeah. Sounds good.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Eunhwa...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We'll join the Four Beasts to take down Liberalio.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: The rest of you keep going to face the Queen.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We'll join you when we're done.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Are you sure...? You've only ever fought against them. You're not exactly on good terms.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Well, given everything, I'm sure they'll be able to figure out why we're there.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: As long as the four of them aren't complete idiots, it won't be an issue.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Wh-why did everyone get so quiet?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I-it's nothing. Yeah. They're, uh... smart.
... Anyway, thank you.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah, thanks for taking care of it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Sure. Leave it to us.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Brid, could you please make a brief stop?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: We can't really come to a full stop, but I'll reduce our speed.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I-it's okay. We can just jump off.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: That way we'll look even more tactical...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: How so...?

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: All right. I'll open the door!
The AZX's door opens, and wind rips through the car.
Absolute stands in front of the door and looks at us.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: See you soon, Rapi.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Good luck, everyone.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: See you later, Commander.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Good luck! Tactical!
The three of them nod their heads and jump.
The distance between us grows rapidly.
Let's keep going.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Yeah. We'll stay on course without slowing down.
The three Nikkes who jumped off the AZX run in the direction the Commander pointed out.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You look happy.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Hm? Yeah, maybe I am.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Ooh! Is it because you got to see everyone for the first time in so long?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I doubt it...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Then why...?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I think... we'll find out when we get there.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Heh. Let's go.
